title: Support --roi-root/--audio-root overrides even with absolute paths in manifest
description:
## Context
The full birdsong manifest stores absolute audio_dir/roi_dir per entry. Current scripts prefer those fields and only fall back to CLI --audio-root/--roi-root when missing, which blocks relocating ROI outputs off ExFAT and blocks running ROI on cloud mounts/object-store synced directories.

## Goal
Make CLI root flags override manifest absolute paths in a predictable way (while remaining backward compatible when relative info is missing).

## Proposed Behavior
- If --audio-root is provided, resolve audio_dir as <audio_root>/<audio_dir_rel> when audio_dir_rel is present; otherwise fall back to manifest audio_dir.
- If --roi-root is provided, resolve roi_dir as <roi_root>/<audio_dir_rel> when audio_dir_rel is present; otherwise fall back to manifest roi_dir.
- If no override is provided, keep existing behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- scripts/run_birdsong_roi.py, scripts/run_birdsong_validation.py, scripts/launch_birdsong_training.py, and scripts/report_birdsong_roi_coverage.py all honor the override behavior above.
- Add a small unit test that constructs a minimal manifest entry (with audio_dir_rel, audio_dir, roi_dir) and asserts override resolution.
- No behavior regression for medium manifest workflows.

title: Investigate AVA-side silence compaction for low-energy frames
description:
Problem

Recent student-side analysis in juvenile_learning_tda suggests the current topology-distilled student is collapsing geometry and over-smoothing temporal structure. If silence compaction is a real part of the target geometry we want the student to inherit, it should be introduced on the AVA/teacher side rather than only as a student-side auxiliary loss.

Why this belongs in AVA

- The student should distill teacher geometry, not invent a better silence structure than the teacher has.
- The current AVA-adjacent mechanism in juvenile_learning_tda is Level 0.1 distance-image silence gating, which is teacher-target shaping rather than upstream AVA latent compaction.
- We need to decide whether the right AVA-side intervention is:
  1. teacher-target gating / silence-aware target construction, or
  2. a change to the upstream AVA embedding geometry itself so low-energy frames already map to a compact basin.

Requested work

- Review the existing AVA export / latent pipeline and identify the cleanest intervention point for teacher-side silence compaction.
- Distinguish clearly between post-hoc distance-image gating and true latent-space compaction.
- Propose or run a controlled ablation on the current packaged lineage to test whether AVA-side silence handling improves downstream topology-readiness without flattening vocal-vocal geometry.
- Record risks, especially any tendency for silence handling to dominate min-max normalization or compress useful song structure.

Context from downstream repo

- juvenile_learning_tda currently has optional teacher-target silence gating (Level 0.1), but its own notes warn that strong gating before min-max can compress vocal geometry.
- The downstream question is whether silence compaction should be owned by AVA rather than by the student objective.
acceptance_criteria: Document the AVA-side intervention point, run or specify a controlled ablation against the current packaged lineage, evaluate whether low-energy frames become more reusable/compact without unacceptable compression of vocal geometry, and identify the exact artifact or config handoff needed by juvenile_learning_tda.

title: Make training scalable to full manifest (avoid loading all ROI into memory at init)
description:
## Context
The current full-scale birdsong manifest references ~3.8M wav files. Existing dataset code paths include loaders that read ROI text files into memory at dataset initialization, which is not feasible at full scale.

## Goal
Implement a scalable training data pipeline that can train over the full manifest by streaming ROI and audio on demand.

## Proposed Approach
- Introduce a dataset implementation that:
  - enumerates examples lazily (or via an index/parquet)
  - reads ROI for a clip on demand (from txt or bundled parquet)
  - optionally caches small computed artifacts (spectrograms or ROI parsing) with bounded size
- Ensure DDP correctness (no duplicated writes, deterministic sharding).

## Acceptance Criteria
- A new dataset/dataloader path can iterate over a large synthetic manifest (and/or a real subset) without O(N) ROI loads at init.
- Memory usage stays bounded (no proportional growth with file count).
- Existing medium-manifest training scripts still work.
